statements.status_notes: Upstream commit bc3293299bc4981e83b7f37f3615a6b9b27b6837 adds a default 2 GB maxmem cap in the JBIG decoder to mitigate denial-of-service via oversized BIE headers (CVE-2017-9937). The DHI package applies that fix on top of Debian jbigkit 2.1-6.1. See https://repo.or.cz/jbigkit.git/commit/bc3293299bc4981e83b7f37f3615a6b9b27b6837 and https://security-tracker.debian.org/tracker/CVE-2017-9937
